result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Sparkling may assign without consent to affiliates and transaction successors; Garman’s other assignments require Sparkling’s consent subject to a reasonableness standard and are absolutely prohibited to Sparkling competitors; and Sparkling’s change of control creates no Garman termination, suspension, or repricing right. The conforming cross-reference in Section 20(c) is necessary to avoid conflict with these assignment rights, while leaving the separate restrictions on transferring, leasing, exporting, or sublicensing the Work intact. The notice requirement and added transaction terminology are limited, customary assignment mechanics and do not materially depart from the playbook.
